title: Trespassed Woman Refuses To Leave Store, Police Escort Her Out
description:
On July 15th, 2022, officers responded to a case of trespass. The reported female was causing a disturbance at a Starbucks outlet. Here's what happened when the police arrived. One of the officers removed the Taser needle from the suspect's back. Soon after, the female was transported to a hospital. The female was charged with resisting arrest and battery upon a peace officer.
